verses.en: The word of the Lord that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel qui fut adressée à Osée, fils de Beéri, au temps d''Ozias, de Jotham, d''Achaz, d''Ezéchias, rois de Juda, et au temps de Jéroboam, fils de Joas, roi d''Israël.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ነገሥታት በዖዝያንና በኢዮአታም በአካዝና በሕዝቅያስም ዘመን በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በዮአስ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም ዘመን ወደ ብኤሪ ልጅ ወደ ሆሴዕ የመጣ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: The beginning of the word of the Lord by Hosea. And the Lord said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the Lord.
verses.fr: La première fois que l''Eternel adressa la parole à Osée, l''Eternel dit à Osée: Va, prends une femme prostituée et des enfants de prostitution; car le pays se prostitue, il abandonne l''Eternel!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መጀመሪያ በሆሴዕ በተናገረ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር ሆሴዕን። ምድሪቱ ከእግዚአብሔር ርቃ ታላቅ ግልሙትና ታደርጋለችና ሂድ፤ ጋለሞታን ሴትና የግልሙትናን ልጆች ለአንተ ውሰድ አለው።

verses.en: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.
verses.fr: Il alla, et il prit Gomer, fille de Diblaïm. Elle conçut, et lui enfanta un fils.
verses.am: እርሱም ሄዶ የዴቤላይምን ልጅ ጎሜርን አገባ፤ እርስዋም ፀነሰች ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel lui dit: Appelle-le du nom de Jizreel; car encore un peu de temps, et je châtierai la maison de Jéhu pour le sang versé à Jizreel, je mettrai fin au royaume de la maison d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ከጥቂት ዘመን በኋላ የኢይዝራኤልን ደም በኢዩ ቤት ላይ እበቀላለሁና፥ ከእስራኤልም ቤት መንግሥትን እሽራለሁና ስሙን ኢይዝራኤል ብለህ ጥራው፤

verses.en: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel, in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, je briserai l''arc d''Israël dans la vallée de Jizreel.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን በኢይዝራኤል ሸለቆ ውስጥ የእስራኤልን ቀስት እሰብራለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Loruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.
verses.fr: Elle conçut de nouveau, et enfanta une fille. Et l''Eternel dit à Osée: Donne-lui le nom de Lo-Ruchama; car je n''aurai plus pitié de la maison d''Israël, je ne lui pardonnerai plus.
verses.am: ደግሞ ፀነሰች ሴት ልጅንም ወለደች። እግዚአብሔርም። ይቅር እላቸው ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ቤት ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አልምርምና ስምዋን ሎሩሃማ ብለህ ጥራት፤

verses.en: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the Lord their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
verses.fr: Mais j''aurai pitié de la maison de Juda; je les sauverai par l''Eternel, leur Dieu, et je ne les sauverai ni par l''arc, ni par l''épée, ni par les combats, ni par les chevaux, ni par les cavaliers.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የይሁዳን ቤት እምራለሁ፤ በአምላካቸውም በእግዚአብሔር አድናቸዋለሁ እንጂ በቀስት ወይም በሰይፍ ወይም በሰልፍ ወይም በፈረሶች ወይም በፈረሰኞች አላድናቸውም አለው።

verses.en: Now when she had weaned Loruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
verses.fr: Elle sevra Lo-Ruchama; puis elle conçut, et enfanta un fils.
verses.am: ሎሩሃማም ጡት ባስጣለች ጊዜ፥ ደግሞ ፀነሰች ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች።

verses.en: Then said God, Call his name Loammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit: Donne-lui le nom de Lo-Ammi; car vous n''êtes pas mon peuple, et je ne suis pas votre Dieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ሕዝቤ አይደላችሁምና፥ እኔም አምላክ አልሆናችሁምና ስሙን ሎዓሚ ብለህ ጥራው አለው።

verses.en: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.
verses.fr: Cependant le nombre des enfants d''Israël sera comme le sable de la mer, qui ne peut ni se mesurer ni se compter; et au lieu qu''on leur disait: Vous n''êtes pas mon peuple! on leur dira: Fils du Dieu vivant!

verses.en: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
verses.fr: Les enfants de Juda et les enfants d''Israël se rassembleront, se donneront un chef, et sortiront du pays; car grande sera la journée de Jizreel.

verses.en: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.
verses.fr: Dites à vos frères: Ammi! et à vos soeurs: Ruchama!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ቍጥር እንደማይሰፈርና እንደማይቈጠር እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ ይሆናል፤ እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እናንተ ሕዝቤ አይደላችሁም ተብሎ በተነገረበት በዚያ ስፍራ የሕያው አምላክ ልጆች ይባላሉ።

verses.en: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
verses.fr: Plaidez, plaidez contre votre mère, car elle n''est point ma femme, et je ne suis point son mari! Qu''elle ôte de sa face ses prostitutions, et de son sein ses adultères!
verses.am: የይሁዳ ልጆችና የእስራኤል ልጆች በአንድነት ይሰበሰባሉ፥ ለእነርሱም አንድ አለቃ ይሾማሉ፥ ከምድሪቱም ይወጣሉ፤ የኢይዝራኤል ቀን ታላቅ ይሆናልና።

verses.en: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
verses.fr: Sinon, je la dépouille à nu, je la mets comme au jour de sa naissance, je la rends semblable à un désert, à une terre aride, et je la fais mourir de soif;
verses.am: ወንድሞቻችሁን። ዓሚ፥ እኅቶቻችሁንም። ሩሃማ በሉአቸው።

verses.en: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.
verses.fr: et je n''aurai pas pitié de ses enfants, car ce sont des enfants de prostitution.
verses.am: እናታችሁ ሚስቴ አይደለችምና፥ እኔም ባልዋ አይደለሁምና ተምዋገቱ፤ ከእናታችሁ ጋር ተምዋገቱ። ግልሙትናዋን ከፊትዋ፥ ምንዝርናዋንም ከጡቶችዋ መካከል ታስወግድ፤

verses.en: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
verses.fr: Leur mère s''est prostituée, celle qui les a conçus s''est déshonorée, car elle a dit: J''irai après mes amants, qui me donnent mon pain et mon eau, ma laine et mon lin, mon huile et ma boisson.
verses.am: ዕራቁትዋን እንዳልገፍፋት፥ እንደ ተወለደችበትም ቀን እንዳላደርጋት፥ እንደ ምድረ በዳና እንደ ደረቅ ምድር እንዳላደርጋት፥ በጥማትም እንዳልገድላት፤

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, je vais fermer son chemin avec des épines et y élever un mur, afin qu''elle ne trouve plus ses sentiers.
verses.am: የግልሙትናዋ ልጆች ናቸውና ልጆችዋን አልምርም።

verses.en: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
verses.fr: Elle poursuivra ses amants, et ne les atteindra pas; elle les cherchera, et ne les trouvera pas. Puis elle dira: J''irai, et je retournerai vers mon premier mari, car alors j''étais plus heureuse que maintenant.
verses.am: እናታቸው አመንዝራለች፤ የፀነሰቻቸውም። እንጀራዬንና ውኃዬን፥ ጥጤንና የተልባ እግሬን፥ ዘይቴንና መጠጤን ከሚሰጡኝ ከውሽሞቼ በኋላ እሄዳለሁ ብላ አስነወረቻቸው።

verses.en: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
verses.fr: Elle n''a pas reconnu que c''était moi qui lui donnais le blé, le moût et l''huile; et l''on a consacré au service de Baal l''argent et l''or que je lui prodiguais.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ መንገድሽን በእሾህ እዘጋለሁ፥ መንገድዋንም እንዳታገኝ ቅጥርን እቀጥርባታለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je reprendrai mon blé en son temps et mon moût dans sa saison, et j''enlèverai ma laine et mon lin qui devaient couvrir sa nudité.
verses.am: ውሽሞችዋንም ትከተላለች፥ ነገር ግን አትደርስባቸውም፤ ትፈልጋቸውማለች፥ ነገር ግን አታገኛቸውም፤ እርስዋም። ከዛሬ ይልቅ የዚያን ጊዜ ይሻለኝ ነበርና ተመልሼ ወደ ቀደመው ባሌ እሄዳለሁ ትላለች።

verses.en: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
verses.fr: Et maintenant je découvrirai sa honte aux yeux de ses amants, et nul ne la délivrera de ma main.
verses.am: እርስዋም እህልንና ወይንን ጠጅ ዘይትንም የሰጠኋት፥ ለበኣልም የተሠራውን ብርና ወርቅ ያበዛሁላት እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ አላወቀችም።

verses.en: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
verses.fr: Je ferai cesser toute sa joie, ses fêtes, ses nouvelles lunes, ses sabbats et toutes ses solennités.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እህሌን በጊዜዋ፥ ወይን ጠጄንም በወረትዋ እወስዳለሁ፥ ዕራቁትነትዋንም እንዳትሸፍን ጥጤንና የተልባ እግሬን እገፍፋታለሁ።

verses.en: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
verses.fr: Je ravagerai ses vignes et ses figuiers, dont elle disait: C''est le salaire que m''ont donné mes amants! Je les réduirai en une forêt, et les bêtes des champs les dévoreront.
verses.am: አሁንም ውሽሞችዋ እያዩ ነውርዋን እገልጣለሁ፤ ከእጄም ማንም አያድናትም።

verses.en: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Je la châtierai pour les jours où elle encensait les Baals, où elle se paraît de ses anneaux et de ses colliers, allait après ses amants, et m''oubliait, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: ደስታዋንም ሁሉ፥ በዓላቶችዋንም፥ መባቻዎችዋንም፥ ሰንበቶችዋንም፥ የተቀደሱትንም ጉባኤዎችን ሁሉ አስቀራለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi voici, je veux l''attirer et la conduire au désert, et je parlerai à son coeur.
verses.am: እርስዋም። ውሽሞቼ የሰጡኝ ዋጋዬ ይህ ነው ያለችውን ወይንዋንና በለስዋን አጠፋለሁ፤ ዱርም አደርገዋለሁ፥ የምድረ በዳም አራዊት ይበሉታል።

verses.en: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Là, je lui donnerai ses vignes et la vallée d''Acor, comme une porte d''espérance, et là, elle chantera comme au temps de sa jeunesse, et comme au jour où elle remonta du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እኔን ረስታ ውሽሞችዋን እየተከተለች፥ በጕትቾችዋና በጌጥዋም እያጌጠች ለበኣሊም ያጠነችበትን ወራት እበቀልባታለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And it shall be at that day, saith the Lord, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, dit l''Eternel, tu m''appelleras: Mon mari! et tu ne m''appelleras plus: Mon maître!
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ አባብላታለሁ፥ ወደ ምድረ በዳም አመጣታለሁ፥ ለልብዋም እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
verses.fr: J''ôterai de sa bouche les noms des Baals, afin qu''on ne les mentionne plus par leurs noms.
verses.am: ከዚያም የወይን ቦታዋን፥ የተስፋ በርም እንዲሆንላት የአኮርን ሸለቆ እሰጣታለሁ፤ በዚያም ከግብጽ ምድር እንደ ወጣችበት ቀን እንደ ሕፃንነትዋ ወራት ትዘምራለች።

verses.en: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, je traiterai pour eux une alliance avec les bêtes des champs, les oiseaux du ciel et les reptiles de la terre, je briserai dans le pays l''arc, l''épée et la guerre, et je les ferai reposer avec sécurité.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ባሌ ብለሽ ትጠሪኛለሽ እንጂ ዳግመኛ በኣሌ ብለሽ አትጠሪኝም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
verses.fr: Je serai ton fiancé pour toujours; je serai ton fiancé par la justice, la droiture, la grâce et la miséricorde;
verses.am: የበኣሊምን ስም ከአፍዋ አስወግደዋለሁና፥ በስማቸውም እንግዲህ አይታሰቡምና።

verses.en: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the Lord.
verses.fr: je serai ton fiancé par la fidélité, et tu reconnaîtras l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ከምድር አራዊትና ከሰማይ ወፎች ከመሬትም ተንቀሳቃሾች ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደርግላቸዋለሁ፤ ቀስትንና ሰይፍን ሰልፍንም ከምድሩ እሰብራለሁ፥ ተከልለውም እንዲኖሩ አስተኛቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the Lord, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
verses.fr: En ce jour-là, j''exaucerai, dit l''Eternel, j''exaucerai les cieux, et ils exauceront la terre;
verses.am: ለዘላለምም ለእኔ እንድትሆኚ አጭሻለሁ፤ በጽድቅና በፍርድ በምሕረትና በርኅራኄ አጭሻለሁ።

verses.en: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
verses.fr: la terre exaucera le blé, le moût et l''huile, et ils exauceront Jizreel.
verses.am: ለእኔም እንድትሆኚ በመታመን አጭሻለሁ፤ አንቺም እግዚአብሔርን ታውቂአለሽ።

verses.en: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.
verses.fr: Je planterai pour moi Lo-Ruchama dans le pays, et je lui ferai miséricorde; je dirai à Lo-Ammi: Tu es mon peuple! et il répondra: Mon Dieu!
verses.am: በዚያንም ቀን እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለሰማይ እመልሳለሁ፥ ሰማይም ለምድር ይመልሳል፤

verses.en: Then said the Lord unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the Lord toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
verses.fr: L''Eternel me dit: Va encore, et aime une femme aimée d''un amant, et adultère; aime-la comme l''Eternel aime les enfants d''Israël, qui se tournent vers d''autres dieux et qui aiment les gâteaux de raisins.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። የእስራኤል ልጆች ወደ ሌሎች አማልክት ቢመለሱና የዘቢብ ጥፍጥፍን ቢወድዱ እንኳ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንደሚወድዳቸው አንተም ውሽማዋን የምትወድደውን አመንዝራይትን ሴት ውደድ አለኝ።

verses.en: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:
verses.fr: Je l''achetai pour quinze sicles d''argent, un homer d''orge et un léthec d''orge.
verses.am: እኔም በአሥራ አምስት ብርና በአንድ ቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ተኩል ገብስ ገዛኋት።

verses.en: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.
verses.fr: Et je lui dis: Reste longtemps pour moi, ne te livre pas à la prostitution, ne sois à aucun homme, et je serai de même envers toi.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ብዙ ወራት ተቀመጪ፥ አታመንዝሪም፥ ለሌላ ሰውም አትሁኚ፤ እኔም እንዲሁ እሆንልሻለሁ አልኋት።

verses.en: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:
verses.fr: Car les enfants d''Israël resteront longtemps sans roi, sans chef, sans sacrifice, sans statue, sans éphod, et sans théraphim.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ያለ ንጉሥና ያለ አለቃ፥ ያለ መሥዋዕትና ያለ ዓምድ፥ ያለ ኤፉድና ያለ ተራፊም ብዙ ወራት ይቀመጣሉና፤

verses.en: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the Lord their God, and David their king; and shall fear the Lord and his goodness in the latter days.
verses.fr: Après cela, les enfants d''Israël reviendront; ils chercheront l''Eternel, leur Dieu, et David, leur roi; et ils tressailliront à la vue de l''Eternel et de sa bonté, dans la suite des temps.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ የእስራኤል ልጆች ተመልሰው አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርንና ንጉሣቸውን ዳዊትን ይፈልጋሉ፤ በኋለኛውም ዘመን ፈርተው ወደ እግዚአብሔርና ወደ በረከቱ ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel: for the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.fr: Ecoutez la parole de l''Eternel, enfants d''Israël! Car l''Eternel a un procès avec les habitants du pays, Parce qu''il n''y a point de vérité, point de miséricorde, Point de connaissance de Dieu dans le pays.
verses.am: እናንተ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ እውነትና ምሕረት እግዚአብሔርንም ማወቅ በምድር ስለሌለ እግዚአብሔር በምድሩ ላይ ከሚኖሩ ጋር ክርክር አለውና የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
verses.fr: Il n''y a que parjures et mensonges, Assassinats, vols et adultères; On use de violence, on commet meurtre sur meurtre.
verses.am: እርግማንና ሐሰት ግዳይና ስርቆት ምንዝርናም ወጥተዋል፤ ደምም ወደ ደም ደርሶአል።

verses.en: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi le pays sera dans le deuil, Tous ceux qui l''habitent seront languissants, Et avec eux les bêtes des champs et les oiseaux du ciel; Même les poissons de la mer disparaîtront.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ምድሪቱ ታለቅሳለች፥ በእርስዋም የሚቀመጡ ሁሉ ከምድር አራዊትና ከሰማይ ወፎች ጋር ይደክማሉ፤ የባሕሩም ዓሦች ያልቃሉ።

verses.en: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
verses.fr: Mais que nul ne conteste, que nul ne se livre aux reproches; Car ton peuple est comme ceux qui disputent avec les sacrificateurs.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሕዝብህ ከካህን ጋር እንደሚከራከሩ ናቸውና ማንም አይከራከር፥ ማንም አይዝለፍ።

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
verses.fr: Tu tomberas de jour, Le prophète avec toi tombera de nuit, Et je détruirai ta mère.
verses.am: በቀንም ትሰናከላለህ፥ ነቢዩም ከአንተ ጋር በሌሊት ይሰናከላል፤ እናትህንም አጠፋታለሁ።

verses.en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
verses.fr: Mon peuple est détruit, parce qu''il lui manque la connaissance. Puisque tu as rejeté la connaissance, Je te rejetterai, et tu seras dépouillé de mon sacerdoce; Puisque tu as oublié la loi de ton Dieu, J''oublierai aussi tes enfants.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ እውቀት ከማጣቱ የተነሣ ጠፍቶአል፤ አንተም እውቀትን ጠልተሃልና እኔ ካህን እንዳትሆነኝ እጠላሃለሁ፤ የአምላክህንም ሕግ ረስተሃልና እኔ ደግሞ ልጆችህን እረሳለሁ።

verses.en: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
verses.fr: Plus ils se sont multipliés, plus ils ont péché contre moi: Je changerai leur gloire en ignominie.
verses.am: እንደ ብዛታቸው መጠን ኃጢአት ሠሩብኝ፤ እኔም ክብራቸውን ወደ ነውር እለውጣለሁ።

verses.en: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.fr: Ils se repaissent des péchés de mon peuple, Ils sont avides de ses iniquités.
verses.am: የሕዝቤም ኃጢአት መብል ሆኖላቸዋል፥ ልባቸውንም ወደ በደላቸው አድርገዋል።

verses.en: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
verses.fr: Il en sera du sacrificateur comme du peuple; Je le châtierai selon ses voies, Je lui rendrai selon ses oeuvres.
verses.am: እንደ ሕዝቡም እንዲሁ ካህኑ ይሆናል፤ በመንገዳቸውም እበቀላቸዋለሁ፥ ሥራቸውንም እመልስባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils mangeront sans se rassasier, Ils se prostitueront sans multiplier, Parce qu''ils ont abandonné l''Eternel et ses commandements.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም መጠበቅ ትተዋልና ሲበሉ አይጠግቡም፥ ሲያመነዝሩም አይበዙም።

verses.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
verses.fr: La prostitution, le vin et le moût, font perdre le sens.
verses.am: ግልሙትናና የወይን ጠጅ ስካርም አእምሮን ያጠፋል።

verses.en: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.
verses.fr: Mon peuple consulte son bois, Et c''est son bâton qui lui parle; Car l''esprit de prostitution égare, Et ils se prostituent loin de leur Dieu.
verses.am: የግልሙትና መንፈስ ሕዝቤን አስቶአቸዋልና፥ እነርሱም ከአምላካቸው ርቀው አመንዝረዋልና በትራቸውን ይጠይቃሉ፥ ዘንጋቸውም ይመልስላቸዋል።

verses.en: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
verses.fr: Ils sacrifient sur le sommet des montagnes, Ils brûlent de l''encens sur les collines, Sous les chênes, les peupliers, les térébinthes, Dont l''ombrage est agréable. C''est pourquoi vos filles se prostituent, Et vos belles-filles sont adultères.
verses.am: በተራሮችም ራስ ላይ ይሠዋሉ፤ ጥላውም መልካም ነውና ከኮምበልና ከልብን ከአሆማም ዛፍ በታች በኮረብቶች ላይ ያጥናሉ፤ ስለዚህ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ይገለሙታሉ፥ ሙሽሮቻችሁም ያመነዝራሉ።

verses.en: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.
verses.fr: Je ne punirai pas vos filles parce qu''elles se prostituent, Ni vos belles-filles parce qu''elles sont adultères, Car eux-mêmes vont à l''écart avec des prostituées, Et sacrifient avec des femmes débauchées. Le peuple insensé court à sa perte.
verses.am: ወንዶችም ደግሞ ከጋለሞቶች ጋር ይጫወታሉና፥ ከጋለሞቶችም ጋር ይሠዋሉና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ በገለሞቱ ጊዜ፥ ሙሽሮቻችሁም ባመነዘሩ ጊዜ አልቀጣቸውም፤ የማያስተውልም ሕዝብ ይገለበጣል።

verses.en: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Bethaven, nor swear, The Lord liveth.
verses.fr: Si tu te livres à la prostitution, ô Israël, Que Juda ne se rende pas coupable; N''allez pas à Guilgal, ne montez pas à Beth-Aven, Et ne jurez pas: L''Eternel est vivant!
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አንተ ብታመነዝር ይሁዳ አይበድል፤ እናንተም ወደ ጌልገላ አትግቡ፥ ወደ ቤትአዌንም አትውጡ፥ ወይም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ብላችሁ አትማሉ።

verses.en: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the Lord will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
verses.fr: Parce qu''Israël se révolte comme une génisse indomptable, Maintenant l''Eternel le fera paître Comme un agneau dans de vastes plaines.
verses.am: እስራኤል እንደ እልከኛ ጊደር እንቢ ብሎአል፤ እግዚአብሔርስ በሰፊው ቦታ እንደ ጠቦት ያሰማራዋልን?

verses.en: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
verses.fr: Ephraïm est attaché aux idoles: laisse-le!
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ከጣዖታት ጋር ተጋጠመ፤ ተወው።

verses.en: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.
verses.fr: A peine ont-ils cessé de boire Qu''ils se livrent à la prostitution; Leurs chefs sont avides d''ignominie.
verses.am: ስካርን ፈጽመዋል፥ ግልሙትናንም አብዝተዋል፤ አለቆችዋም ነውርን እጅግ ወደዱ።

verses.en: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.fr: Le vent les enveloppera de ses ailes, Et ils auront honte de leurs sacrifices.
verses.am: ነፋስ በክንፍዋ አስሮአታል፤ ከመሥዋዕታቸውም የተነሣ ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.fr: Ecoutez ceci, sacrificateurs! Sois attentive, maison d''Israël! Prête l''oreille, maison du roi! Car c''est à vous que le jugement s''adresse, Parce que vous avez été un piège à Mitspa, Et un filet tendu sur le Thabor.
verses.am: ካህናት ሆይ፥ ይህን ስሙ፤ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ አድምጡ፤ የንጉሥ ቤት ሆይ፥ ልብ አድርጉ፤ በምጽጳ ላይ ወጥመድ፥ በታቦርም ላይ የተዘረጋ አሽክላ ሆናችኋልና ፍርድ በእናንተ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
verses.fr: Par leurs sacrifices, les infidèles s''enfoncent dans le crime, Mais j''aurai des châtiments pour eux tous.
verses.am: ዓመፀኞችም እርድ አብዝተዋል፤ እኔ ግን እነዚያን ሁሉ እዘልፋለሁ።

verses.en: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.
verses.fr: Je connais Ephraïm, Et Israël ne m''est point caché; Car maintenant, Ephraïm, tu t''es prostitué, Et Israël s''est souillé.
verses.am: ኤፍሬምን አውቀዋለሁ፥ እስራኤልም ከእኔ አልተሰወረም፤ ኤፍሬም ሆይ፥ ዛሬ አመንዝረሃል፥ እስራኤልም ረክሶአል።

verses.en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the Lord.
verses.fr: Leurs oeuvres ne leur permettent pas de revenir à leur Dieu, Parce que l''esprit de prostitution est au milieu d''eux, Et parce qu''ils ne connaissent pas l''Eternel.
verses.am: ወደ አምላካቸው ይመለሱ ዘንድ ሥራቸውን አላቀኑም፤ የግልሙትና መንፈስ በውስጣቸው አለና፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አላውቁምና።

verses.en: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity: Judah also shall fall with them.
verses.fr: L''orgueil d''Israël témoigne contre lui; Israël et Ephraïm tomberont par leur iniquité; Avec eux aussi tombera Juda.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ትዕቢት በፊቱ ይመሰክራል፤ ስለዚህ እስራኤልና ኤፍሬም በኃጢአታቸው ይሰናከላሉ፤ ይሁዳም ደግሞ ከእነሱ ጋር ይሰናከላል።

verses.en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the Lord; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
verses.fr: Ils iront avec leurs brebis et leurs boeufs chercher l''Eternel, Mais ils ne le trouveront point: Il s''est retiré du milieu d''eux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም ለመሻት በጎቻቸውንና ላሞቻቸውን ነድተው ይሄዳሉ፤ ነገር ግን እርሱ ከእነርሱም ተመልሶአልና አያገኙትም።

verses.en: They have dealt treacherously against the Lord: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
verses.fr: Ils ont été infidèles à l''Eternel, Car ils ont engendré des enfants illégitimes; Maintenant un mois suffira pour les dévorer avec leurs biens.
verses.am: ዲቃሎችን ልጆች ወልደዋልና እግዚአብሔርን ወንጅለዋል፤ አሁንም አንድ ወር እነርሱንና ርስታቸውን ይበላቸዋል።

verses.en: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Bethaven, after thee, O Benjamin.
verses.fr: Sonnez de la trompette à Guibea, Sonnez de la trompette à Rama! Poussez des cris à Beth-Aven! Derrière toi, Benjamin!
verses.am: በጊብዓ መለከትን፥ በራማ እንቢልታን ንፉና። ብንያም ሆይ፥ ከአንተ በኋላ እያላችሁ በቤትአዌን ላይ እሪ በሉ።

verses.en: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
verses.fr: Ephraïm sera dévasté au jour du châtiment; J''annonce aux tribus d''Israël une chose certaine.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም በዘለፋ ቀን የፈረሰ ይሆናል። በእስራኤል ነገዶች ዘንድ በእርግጥ የሚሆነውን ነገር ገልጫለሁ።

verses.en: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
verses.fr: Les chefs de Juda sont comme ceux qui déplacent les bornes; Je répandrai sur eux ma colère comme un torrent.
verses.am: የይሁዳ አለቆች ድምበርን እንደሚነቅሉ ሆነዋል፤ እኔም መዓቴን እንደ ውኃ አፈስስባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
verses.fr: Ephraïm est opprimé, brisé par le jugement, Car il a suivi les préceptes qui lui plaisaient.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ከትእዛዝ በኋላ መሄድን ወድዶአልና የተገፋና በፍርድ የተጐዳ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
verses.fr: Je serai comme une teigne pour Ephraïm, Comme une carie pour la maison de Juda.
verses.am: እኔም ለኤፍሬም እንደ ብል፥ ለይሁዳም ቤት እንደ ነቀዝ ሆኜአለሁ።

verses.en: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
verses.fr: Ephraïm voit son mal, et Juda ses plaies; Ephraïm se rend en Assyrie, et s''adresse au roi Jareb; Mais ce roi ne pourra ni vous guérir, Ni porter remède à vos plaies.
verses.am: ኤፍሬምም ደዌውን፥ ይሁዳም ቍስሉን ባየ ጊዜ ኤፍሬም ወደ አሦር ሄደ ወደ ንጉሡም ወደ ኢያሪም መልእክተኛን ላከ፤ እርሱ ግን ይፈውሳችሁ ዘንድ፥ ከቊስላችሁም ያድናችሁ ዘንድ አልቻለም።

verses.en: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
verses.fr: Je serai comme un lion pour Ephraïm, Comme un lionceau pour la maison de Juda; Moi, moi, je déchirerai, puis je m''en irai, J''emporterai, et nul n''enlèvera ma proie.
verses.am: እኔም ለኤፍሬም እንደ አንበሳ፥ ለይሁዳም ቤት እንደ አንበሳ ደቦል እሆናለሁና፤ እኔም ነጥቄ እሄዳለሁ እወስድማለሁ፥ የሚያድንም አይገኝም።

verses.en: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
verses.fr: Je m''en irai, je reviendrai dans ma demeure, Jusqu''à ce qu''ils s''avouent coupables et cherchent ma face. Quand ils seront dans la détresse, ils auront recours à moi.
verses.am: በደላቸውንም እስኪያውቁ ድረስ፥ ፊቴንም እስኪሹ ድረስ ሄጄ ወደ ስፍራዬ እመለሳለሁ፤ በመከራቸው ጊዜ እጅግ አድርገው ፊቴን ይፈልጋሉ።

verses.en: Come, and let us return unto the Lord: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
verses.fr: Venez, retournons à l''Eternel! Car il a déchiré, mais il nous guérira; Il a frappé, mais il bandera nos plaies.
verses.am: ኑ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንመለስ፤ እርሱ ሰብሮናልና፥ እርሱም ይፈውሰናል፤ እርሱ መትቶናል፥ እርሱም ይጠግነናል።

verses.en: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
verses.fr: Il nous rendra la vie dans deux jours; Le troisième jour il nous relèvera, Et nous vivrons devant lui.
verses.am: ከሁለት ቀን በኋላ ያድነናል፤ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ያስነሣናል፥ በፊቱም በሕይወት እንኖራለን።

verses.en: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the Lord: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
verses.fr: Connaissons, cherchons à connaître l''Eternel; Sa venue est aussi certaine que celle de l''aurore. Il viendra pour nous comme la pluie, Comme la pluie du printemps qui arrose la terre.
verses.am: እንወቅ፤ እናውቀውም ዘንድ እግዚአብሔርን እንከተል፤ እንደ ወገግታም ተዘጋጅቶ እናገኘዋለን፤ እንደ ዝናብም ምድርንም እንደሚያጠጣ እንደ መጨረሻ ዝናብ ይመጣል።

verses.en: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
verses.fr: Que te ferai-je, Ephraïm? Que te ferai-je, Juda? Votre piété est comme la nuée du matin, Comme la rosée qui bientôt se dissipe.
verses.am: ምሕረታችሁ እንደ ማለዳ ደመና፥ በማለዳም እንደሚያልፍ ጠል ነውና ኤፍሬም ሆይ፥ ምን ላድርግልህ? ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ ምን ላድርግልህ?

verses.en: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je les frapperai par les prophètes, Je les tuerai par les paroles de ma bouche, Et mes jugements éclateront comme la lumière.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በነቢያት እጅ ቈረጥኋቸው፥ በአፌም ቃል ገደልኋቸው፤ ፍርዴም እንደ ብርሃን ይወጣል።

verses.en: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.fr: Car j''aime la piété et non les sacrifices, Et la connaissance de Dieu plus que les holocaustes.
verses.am: ከመሥዋዕት ይልቅ ምሕረትን፥ ከሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት ይልቅ እግዚአብሔርን ማወቅ እወድዳለሁና።

verses.en: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
verses.fr: Ils ont, comme le vulgaire, transgressé l''alliance; C''est alors qu''ils m''ont été infidèles.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን እንደ አዳም ቃል ኪዳንን ተላልፈዋል፤ በዚያም ላይ ወንጅለውኛል።

verses.en: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
verses.fr: Galaad est une ville de malfaiteurs, Elle porte des traces de sang.
verses.am: ገለዓድ ኃጢአትን የሚሠሩ ሰዎች ከተማ፥ በደምም የተቀባ ነው።

verses.en: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
verses.fr: La troupe des sacrificateurs est comme une bande en embuscade, Commettant des assassinats sur le chemin de Sichem; Car ils se livrent au crime.
verses.am: ለሰውም እንደሚያደቡ ወንበዴዎች፥ እንዲሁ የካህናት ወገኖች በሴኬም መንገድ ላይ ይገድላሉ፤ ሴሰኝነትንም ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
verses.fr: Dans la maison d''Israël j''ai vu des choses horribles: Là Ephraïm se prostitue, Israël se souille.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ቤት የሚያስፈራን ነገር አይቻለሁ፤ በዚያ በኤፍሬም ውስጥ ግልሙትና ተገኘ፥ እስራኤልም ረክሶአል።

verses.en: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
verses.fr: A toi aussi, Juda, une moisson est préparée, Quand je ramènerai les captifs de mon peuple.
verses.am: ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ የሕዝቤን ምርኮ በምመልስበት ጊዜ ለአንተ ደግሞ መከር ተወስኖልሃል።

verses.en: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.
verses.fr: Lorsque je voulais guérir Israël, L''iniquité d''Ephraïm et la méchanceté de Samarie se sont révélées, Car ils ont agi frauduleusement; Le voleur est arrivé, la bande s''est répandue au dehors.
verses.am: በሐሰት አድርገዋልና፥ ሌባም ገብቶአልና፥ በውጭም ወንበዴዎች ቀምተዋልና እስራኤልን እፈውስ ዘንድ በወደድሁ ጊዜ የኤፍሬም ኃጢአትና የሰማርያ ክፋት ተገለጠ።

verses.en: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
verses.fr: Ils ne se disent pas dans leur coeur Que je me souviens de toute leur méchanceté; Maintenant leurs oeuvres les entourent, Elles sont devant ma face.
verses.am: እኔም ክፋታቸውን ሁሉ እንዳሰብሁ በልባቸው አያስቡም አሁንም ሥራቸው ከብባቸዋለች፥ በፊቴም አለች።

verses.en: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.fr: Ils réjouissent le roi par leur méchanceté, Et les chefs par leurs mensonges.
verses.am: ንጉሡን በክፋታቸው፥ አለቆቹንም በሐሰታቸው ደስ አሰኝተዋል።

verses.en: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
verses.fr: Ils sont tous adultères, Semblables à un four chauffé par le boulanger: Il cesse d''attiser le feu Depuis qu''il a pétri la pâte jusqu''à ce qu''elle soit levée.
verses.am: ሁሉም አመንዝራዎች ናቸው፤ ጋጋሪ እንደሚያነድድበት እንደ ምድጃ ናቸው፤ ሁሉ እስኪቦካ ድረስ እሳትን መቈስቈስና እርሾን መለወስ ይቆያል።

verses.en: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
verses.fr: Au jour de notre roi, Les chefs se rendent malades par les excès du vin; Le roi tend la main aux moqueurs.
verses.am: በንጉሣችን ቀን አለቆች ከወይን ጠጅ ሙቀት የተነሣ ታመሙ፤ እርሱም ከዋዘኞች ጋር እጁን ዘረጋ።

verses.en: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
verses.fr: Ils appliquent aux embûches leur coeur pareil à un four; Toute la nuit dort leur boulanger, Et au matin le four brûle comme un feu embrasé.
verses.am: እያደቡ ልባቸውን እንደ ምድጃ አዘጋጅተዋል፤ አበዛቸውም ሌሊቱን ሁሉ አንቀላፋ፤ በጠባም ጊዜ እንደ እሳት ነበልባል ይነድዳል።

verses.en: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.
verses.fr: Ils sont tous ardents comme un four, Et ils dévorent leurs juges; Tous leurs rois tombent: Aucun d''eux ne m''invoque.
verses.am: ሁሉም እንደ ምድጃ ግለዋል፥ ፈራጆቻቸውንም በሉ፤ ነገሥታቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ወደቁ፤ ከእነርሱም ወደ እኔ የሚጮኽ የለም።

verses.en: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
verses.fr: Ephraïm se mêle avec les peuples, Ephraïm est un gâteau qui n''a pas été retourné.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ከአሕዛብ ጋር ተደባለቀ፤ ኤፍሬም እንዳልተገላበጠ ቂጣ ነው።

verses.en: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
verses.fr: Des étrangers consument sa force, Et il ne s''en doute pas; La vieillesse s''empare de lui, Et il ne s''en doute pas.
verses.am: እንግዶች ጕልበቱን በሉት፥ እርሱም አላወቀም፤ ሽበትም ወጣበት፥ እርሱም አላወቀም።

verses.en: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the Lord their God, nor seek him for all this.
verses.fr: L''orgueil d''Israël témoigne contre lui; Ils ne reviennent pas à l''Eternel, leur Dieu, Et ils ne le cherchent pas, malgré tout cela.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ትዕቢቱ በፊቱ መሰከረ፤ ወደ አምላካቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ግን አልተመለሱም፥ በዚህም ሁሉ አልፈለጉትም።

verses.en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.fr: Ephraïm est comme une colombe stupide, sans intelligence; Ils implorent l''Egypte, ils vont en Assyrie.
verses.am: ኤፍሬምም አእምሮ እንደሌላት እንደ ሰነፍ ርግብ ነው፤ ግብጽን ጠሩ፥ ወደ አሦርም ሄዱ።

verses.en: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
verses.fr: S''ils partent, j''étendrai sur eux mon filet, Je les précipiterai comme les oiseaux du ciel; Je les châtierai, comme ils en ont été avertis dans leur assemblée.
verses.am: ሲሄዱ አሽክላዬን አዘረጋባቸዋለሁ፤ እንደ ሰማይ ወፎች አወርዳቸዋለሁ፤ መከራቸውን ሲሰሙ እገሥጻቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
verses.fr: Malheur à eux, parce qu''ils me fuient! Ruine sur eux, parce qu''ils me sont infidèles! Je voudrais les sauver, Mais ils disent contre moi des paroles mensongères.
verses.am: ከእኔ ፈቀቅ ብለዋልና ወዮላቸው! በእኔም ላይ ዐመፀዋልና ጥፋት ይምጣባቸው! እኔ ልታደጋቸው ወደድሁ፥ እነርሱ ግን በሐሰት ተናገሩብኝ።

verses.en: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
verses.fr: Ils ne crient pas vers moi dans leur coeur, Mais ils se lamentent sur leur couche; Ils se rassemblent pour avoir du blé et du moût, Et ils s''éloignent de moi.
verses.am: በመኝታቸው ላይ ሆነው ያለቅሱ ነበር እንጂ በልባቸው ወደ እኔ አልጮኹም፤ ስለ እህልና ስለ ወይን ጠጅ ይሰበሰቡ ነበር፤ በእኔም ላይ ዐመፁ።

verses.en: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
verses.fr: Je les ai châtiés, j''ai fortifié leurs bras; Et ils méditent le mal contre moi.
verses.am: እኔም ክንዳቸውን አስተማርሁና አጸናሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን ክፉ ነገርን መከሩብኝ።

verses.en: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas au Très-Haut qu''ils retournent; Ils sont comme un arc trompeur. Leurs chefs tomberont par l''épée, A cause de l''insolence de leur langue. C''est ce qui les rendra un objet de risée dans le pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ወደ ከንቱ ነገር ተመለሱ፤ እንደ ተንኰለኛ ቀስት ሆኑ፤ አለቆቻቸው ከምላሳቸው ቍጣ የተነሣ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፤ ይህ በግብጽ ምድር ውስጥ መሳለቂያ ይሆንባቸዋል።

verses.en: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the Lord, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
verses.fr: Embouche la trompette! L''ennemi fond comme un aigle sur la maison de l''Eternel, Parce qu''ils ont violé mon alliance, Et transgressé ma loi.
verses.am: መለከትን ወደ አፍህ አቅርብ፤ ቃል ኪዳኔን ተላልፈዋልና፥ በሕጌም ላይ ዐምፀዋልና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ላይ እንደ ንስር ይመጣል።

verses.en: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.
verses.fr: Ils crieront vers moi: Mon Dieu, nous te connaissons, nous Israël!
verses.am: እነርሱም። አምላክ ሆይ፥ እኛ እስራኤል አወቅንህ ብለው ወደ እኔ ይጮኻሉ።

verses.en: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
verses.fr: Israël a rejeté le bien; L''ennemi le poursuivra.
verses.am: እስራኤል ደግነትን ጥሎአል፤ ጠላትም ያሳድዱታል።

verses.en: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.fr: Ils ont établi des rois sans mon ordre, Et des chefs à mon insu; Ils ont fait des idoles avec leur argent et leur or; C''est pourquoi ils seront anéantis.
verses.am: ለራሳቸው ነገሥታትን አነገሡ፥ ከእኔም ዘንድ አይደለም፤ አለቆችንም አደረጉ፥ እኔም አላወቅሁም፤ ለጥፋታቸውም ከብራቸውና ከወርቃቸው፤ ጣዖታትን ለራሳቸው አደረጉ።

verses.en: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
verses.fr: L''Eternel a rejeté ton veau, Samarie! Ma colère s''est enflammée contre eux. Jusques à quand refuseront-ils de se purifier?
verses.am: ሰማርያ ሆይ፥ እምቦሳህን፤ ጥሎአል፤ ቍጣዬ በላያቸው ነድዶአል፤ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ንጹሕ ሊሆኑ አይችሉም?

verses.en: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.fr: Il vient d''Israël, un ouvrier l''a fabriqué, Et ce n''est pas un Dieu; C''est pourquoi le veau de Samarie sera mis en pièces.
verses.am: ይህ ደግሞ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ ነው፤ ሠራተኛ ሠራው፥ እርሱም አምላክ አይደለም፤ የሰማርያም እምቦሳ ይቈራረጣል።

verses.en: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk; the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
verses.fr: Puisqu''ils ont semé du vent, ils moissonneront la tempête; Ils n''auront pas un épi de blé; Ce qui poussera ne donnera point de farine, Et s''il y en avait, des étrangers la dévoreraient.
verses.am: ነፍስን ዘርተዋል፥ ዐውሎ ነፍስንም ያጭዳሉ፤ አገዳ የለውም፥ ከፍሬውም ዱቄት አይገኝም፤ ቢገኝም እንግዶች ይበሉታል።

verses.en: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
verses.fr: Israël est anéanti! Ils sont maintenant parmi les nations Comme un vase qui n''a pas de prix.
verses.am: እስራኤል ተውጦአል፥ በአሕዛብም መካከል ዛሬ እንደ ረከሰ ዕቃ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
verses.fr: Car ils sont allés en Assyrie, Comme un âne sauvage qui se tient à l''écart; Ephraïm a fait des présents pour avoir des amis.
verses.am: ለብቻውም እንደሚቀመጥ እንደ ምድረ በዳ አህያ ወደ አሦር ወጥተዋል፤ ኤፍሬምም ወዳጆቹን በእጅ መንሻ ገዛ።

verses.en: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
verses.fr: Quand même ils font des présents parmi les nations, Je vais maintenant les rassembler, Et bientôt ils souffriront sous le fardeau du roi des princes.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለአሕዛብ እጅ መንሻ ቢሰጡ እኔ አሁን እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፤ ከንጉሥና ከአለቆችም ሸክም የተነሣ ይደክማሉ።

verses.en: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
verses.fr: Ephraïm a multiplié les autels pour pécher, Et ces autels l''ont fait tomber dans le péché.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ኃጢአትን ለመሥራት መሠዊያ አብዝቶአልና መሠዊያ ለኃጢአት ይሆንለታል።

verses.en: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
verses.fr: Que j''écrive pour lui toutes les ordonnances de ma loi, Elles sont regardées comme quelque chose d''étranger.
verses.am: የሕጌን ብዛት ጽፌለታለሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን እንደ እንግዳ ነገር ቈጥረውታል።

verses.en: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the Lord accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
verses.fr: Ils immolent des victimes qu''ils m''offrent, Et ils en mangent la chair: L''Eternel n''y prend point de plaisir. Maintenant l''Eternel se souvient de leur iniquité, Et il punira leurs péchés: Ils retourneront en Egypte.
verses.am: መሥዋዕቴን ያቀርባሉ፥ ሥጋንም ያርዳሉ፥ ይበላሉም፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን አይቀበላቸውም፤ በደላቸውንም ያስባል፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቀጣል፤ እነርሱም ወደ ግብጽ ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.fr: Israël a oublié celui qui l''a fait, Et a bâti des palais, Et Juda a multiplié les villes fortes; Mais j''enverrai le feu dans leurs villes, Et il en dévorera les palais.
verses.am: እስራኤል ፈጣሪውን ረስቶአል፥ መስገጃዎችንም ሠርቶአል፤ ይሁዳም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች አብዝቶአል፤ እኔ ግን በከተሞች ላይ እሳትን እሰድዳለሁ፥ አዳራሾችንም ትበላለች።

verses.en: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
verses.fr: Israël, ne te livre pas à la joie, à l''allégresse, comme les peuples, De ce que tu t''es prostitué en abandonnant l''Eternel, De ce que tu as aimé un salaire impur dans toutes les aires à blé!
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ከአምላክህ ተለይተህ አመንዝረሃልና እንደ አሕዛብ ደስ አይበልህ፥ ሐሴትንም አታድርግ፤ በእህሉ አውድማ ሁሉ ላይ የግልሙትናን ዋጋ ወድደሃል።

verses.en: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
verses.fr: L''aire et le pressoir ne les nourriront pas, Et le moût leur fera défaut.
verses.am: አውድማውና መጥመቂያው አይመግባቸውም፥ ጉሽ ጠጅም ይጐድልባታል።

verses.en: They shall not dwell in the Lord's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
verses.fr: Ils ne resteront pas dans le pays de l''Eternel; Ephraïm retournera en Egypte, Et ils mangeront en Assyrie des aliments impurs.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ምድር ላይ አይቀመጡም፤ ኤፍሬምም ወደ ግብጽ ይመለሳል፥ በአሦርም ርኩስን ነገር ይበላሉ።

verses.en: They shall not offer wine offerings to the Lord, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils ne feront pas à l''Eternel des libations de vin: Elles ne lui seraient point agréables. Leurs sacrifices seront pour eux comme un pain de deuil; Tous ceux qui en mangeront se rendront impurs; Car leur pain ne sera que pour eux, Il n''entrera point dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም የወይን ጠጅን ቁርባን አያፈስሱም፥ መሥዋዕታቸውም ደስ አያሰኘውም፤ የኀዘንም እንጀራ ይሆንላቸዋል፥ የሚበላውም ሁሉ ይረክሳል፤ እንጀራቸውም ለሰውነታቸው ይሆናል እንጂ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አይገባም።

verses.en: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the Lord?
verses.fr: Que ferez-vous aux jours solennels, Aux jours des fêtes de l''Eternel?
verses.am: በዓመት በዓል ቀንና በእግዚአብሔር በዓል ቀን ምን ታደርጋላችሁ?

verses.en: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
verses.fr: Car voici, ils partent à cause de la dévastation; L''Egypte les recueillera, Moph leur donnera des sépulcres; Ce qu''ils ont de précieux, leur argent, sera la proie des ronces, Et les épines croîtront dans leurs tentes.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከጥፋት ሸሽተው ሄዱ፥ ግብጽም ትሰበስባቸዋለች፥ ሜምፎስም ትቀብራቸዋለች፤ ሳማም የብራቸውን ጌጥ ይወርሳል፥ እሾህም በድንኳኖቻቸው ውስጥ ይበቅላል።

verses.en: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
verses.fr: Ils arrivent, les jours du châtiment, Ils arrivent, les jours de la rétribution: Israël va l''éprouver! Le prophète est fou, l''homme inspiré a le délire, A cause de la grandeur de tes iniquités et de tes rébellions.
verses.am: የበቀል ወራት መጥቶአል፥ የፍዳም ወራት ደርሶአል፥ እስራኤልም ያውቃል፤ ከኃጢአትህና ከጠላትነትህ ብዛት የተነሣ ነቢዩ ሰንፎአል፥ መንፈስም ያለበት ሰው አብዶአል።

verses.en: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.
verses.fr: Ephraïm est une sentinelle contre mon Dieu; Le prophète... un filet d''oiseleur est sur toutes ses voies, Un ennemi dans la maison de son Dieu.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ከአምላኬ ጋር ተመልካች ነበረ፤ አሁን ግን ነቢዩ በመንገዱ ሁሉ ላይ የወፍ ወጥመድ ሆነ፥ በአምላኩም ቤት ጠላትነት አለ።

verses.en: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
verses.fr: Ils sont plongés dans la corruption, comme aux jours de Guibea; L''Eternel se souviendra de leur iniquité, Il punira leurs péchés.
verses.am: በጊብዓ ዘመን እንደ ነበረ እጅግ ረከሱ፤ እርሱም በደላቸውን ያስባል፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይበቀላል።

verses.en: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
verses.fr: J''ai trouvé Israël comme des raisins dans le désert, J''ai vu vos pères comme les premiers fruits d''un figuier; Mais ils sont allés vers Baal-Peor, Ils se sont consacrés à l''infâme idole, Et ils sont devenus abominables comme l''objet de leur amour.
verses.am: እስራኤልን በምድረ በዳ እንዳለ ወይን ሆኖ አገኘሁት፤ አባቶቻችሁንም ከመጀመሪያዋ ዓመት እንደ በለስ በkWraት ሆነው አየኋቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን ወደ ብዔልፌጎር መጡ፥ ለነውርም ተለዩ፥ እንደ ወደዱትም ርኩስ ሆኑ፥

verses.en: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
verses.fr: La gloire d''Ephraïm s''envolera comme un oiseau: Plus de naissance, plus de grossesse, plus de conception.
verses.am: የኤፍሬምም ክብር እንደ ወፍ በርሮ ይጠፋል፤ መውለድና መፅነስ ማርገዝም አይሆንላቸውም።

verses.en: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.fr: S''ils élèvent leurs enfants, Je les en priverai avant qu''ils soient des hommes; Et malheur à eux, quand je les abandonnerai!
verses.am: ልጆቻቸውንም ቢያሳድጉ ሰው እንዳይቀርላቸው ልጅ አልባ አደረጋቸዋለሁ፤ ከእነርሱም በራቅሁ ጊዜ ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
verses.fr: Ephraïm, aussi loin que portent mes regards du côté de Tyr, Est planté dans un lieu agréable; Mais Ephraïm mènera ses enfants vers celui qui les tuera.
verses.am: እኔ እንዳየሁ የኤፍሬም ልጆች ለምርኮ ተሰጥተዋል፤ ኤፍሬምም ልጆቹን ወደ ገዳዩች ያወጣል።

verses.en: Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.fr: Donne-leur, ô Eternel!... Que leur donneras-tu?... Donne-leur un sein qui avorte et des mamelles desséchées!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስጣቸው፤ ምን ትሰጣቸዋለህ? የሚጨነግፍን ማኅፀን የደረቀውንም ጡት ስጣቸው።

verses.en: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
verses.fr: Toute leur méchanceté se montre à Guilgal; C''est là que je les ai pris en aversion. A cause de la malice de leurs oeuvres, Je les chasserai de ma maison. Je ne les aimerai plus; Tous leurs chefs sont des rebelles.
verses.am: ክፋታቸው ሁሉ በጌልገላ አለ፤ በዚያ ጠልቻቸዋለሁ፤ ስለ ሠሩት ክፋት ከቤቴ አሳድዳቸዋለሁ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ አልወድዳቸውም፤ አለቆቻቸው ሁሉ ዓመፀኞች ናቸው።

verses.en: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
verses.fr: Ephraïm est frappé, sa racine est devenue sèche; Ils ne porteront plus de fruit; Et s''ils ont des enfants, Je ferai périr les objets de leur tendresse.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ተመታ፥ ሥሩም ደረቀ፥ ፍሬም አያፈራም፤ ደግሞም ቢወልዱ የማኅፀናቸውን ፍሬ እገድላለሁ።

verses.en: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.fr: Mon Dieu les rejettera, parce qu''ils ne l''ont pas écouté, Et ils seront errants parmi les nations.
verses.am: አልሰሙትምና አምላኬ ይጥላቸዋል፤ በአሕዛብም መካከል ተቅበዝባዦች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
verses.fr: Israël était une vigne féconde, Qui rendait beaucoup de fruits. Plus ses fruits étaient abondants, Plus il a multiplié les autels; Plus son pays était prospère, Plus il a embelli les statues.
verses.am: እስራኤል ፍሬው የበዛለት የለመለመ ወይን ነው፤ እንደ ፍሬው ብዛት መሠዊያውን አብዝቶአል፤ እንደ ምድሩም ማማር መጠን ሐውልቶችን እያሳመሩ ሠርተዋል።

verses.en: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
verses.fr: Leur coeur est partagé: ils vont en porter la peine. L''Eternel renversera leurs autels, détruira leurs statues.
verses.am: ልባቸው ተከፈለ፤ አሁንም በደላቸውን ይሸከማሉ፤ እርሱ መሠዊያቸውን ያፈርሳል፥ ሐውልቶቻቸውን ያጠፋል።

verses.en: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the Lord; what then should a king do to us?
verses.fr: Et bientôt ils diront: Nous n''avons point de roi, Car nous n''avons pas craint l''Eternel; Et le roi, que pourrait-il faire pour nous?
verses.am: አሁንም። ንጉሥ የለንም፥ እግዚአብሔርን አልፈራንምና፤ ንጉሥስ ምን ያደርግልናል? ይላሉ።

verses.en: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.fr: Ils prononcent des paroles vaines, des serments faux, Lorsqu''ils concluent une alliance: Aussi le châtiment germera, comme une plante vénéneuse Dans les sillons des champs.
verses.am: የማይረባውን ቃል ይናገራሉ፤ ቃል ኪዳን በገቡ ጊዜ በሐሰት ይምላሉ፤ ስለዚህ መርዛም ሣር በእርሻ ትልም ላይ እንደሚበቅል መቅሠፍት ይበቅልባቸዋል።

verses.en: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Bethaven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
verses.fr: Les habitants de Samarie seront consternés au sujet des veaux de Beth-Aven; Le peuple mènera deuil sur l''idole, Et ses prêtres trembleront pour elle, Pour sa gloire, qui va disparaître du milieu d''eux.
verses.am: የሰማርያ ሰዎች ስለ ቤትአዌን እምቦሳ ይፈራሉ፤ ክብሩም ከእርሱ ዘንድ ወጥቶአልና ሕዝቡ ያለቅሱለታል፥ የጣዖቱ ካህናትም በኀዘን ይንተባተባሉ።

verses.en: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.fr: Elle sera transportée en Assyrie, Pour servir de présent au roi Jareb. La confusion saisira Ephraïm, Et Israël aura honte de ses desseins.
verses.am: ለንጉሡ ለኢያሪም እጅ መንሻ ይሆን ዘንድ ወደ አሦር ይማረካል፤ ኤፍሬምን እፍረት ይይዘዋል፥ እስራኤልም በምክሩ ያፍራል።

verses.en: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
verses.fr: C''en est fait de Samarie, de son roi, Comme de l''écume à la surface des eaux.
verses.am: ሰማርያ ከንጉሥዋ ጋር በውኃ ላይ እንዳለ አረፋ ጠፍታለች።

verses.en: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
verses.fr: Les hauts lieux de Beth-Aven, où Israël a péché, seront détruits; L''épine et la ronce croîtront sur leurs autels. Ils diront aux montagnes: Couvrez-nous! Et aux collines: Tombez sur nous!
verses.am: የእስራኤል ኃጢአት የሆኑት የአዌን የኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ይፈርሳሉ፤ እሾህና አሜከላ በመሠዊያዎቻቸው ላይ ይበቅላል፤ ተራሮችንም። ክደኑን፥ ኮረብቶችንም። ውደቁብን ይሉአቸዋል።

verses.en: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
verses.fr: Depuis les jours de Guibea tu as péché, Israël! Là ils restèrent debout, La guerre contre les méchants ne les atteignit pas à Guibea.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ከጊብዓ ዘመን ጀምረህ ኃጢአትን ሠርተሃል፤ በዚያ ጸንተዋል፤ በጊብዓ ላይ ሰልፍ አይደርስባቸውምን?

verses.en: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
verses.fr: Je les châtierai à mon gré, Et des peuples s''assembleront contre eux, Quand on les enchaînera pour leur double iniquité.
verses.am: በፈቀድሁም ጊዜ እገሥጻቸዋለሁ፤ ስለ ሁለቱም ኃጢአታቸው በታሰሩ ጊዜ አሕዛብ ይሰበሰቡባቸዋል።

verses.en: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
verses.fr: Ephraïm est une génisse dressée, et qui aime à fouler le grain, Mais je m''approcherai de son beau cou; J''attellerai Ephraïm, Juda labourera, Jacob hersera.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ማበራየት እንደ ለመደች ጊደር ነው፥ እኔ ግን በአንገቱ ውበት እጫንበታለሁ፤ በኤፍሬም ላይ እጠምድበታለሁ፥ ይሁዳም ያርሳል፥ ያዕቆብም አፈሩን ያለሰልሳል።

verses.en: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the Lord, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verses.fr: Semez selon la justice, moissonnez selon la miséricorde, Défrichez-vous un champ nouveau! Il est temps de chercher l''Eternel, Jusqu''à ce qu''il vienne, et répande pour vous la justice.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መጥቶ ጽድቅን እስኪያዘንብላችሁ ድረስ እርሱን የምትሹበት ዘመን ነውና ለእናንተ በጽድቅ ዝሩ፥ እንደ ምሕረቱም መጠን እጨዱ፥ ጥጋታችሁንም እረሱ።

verses.en: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
verses.fr: Vous avez cultivé le mal, moissonné l''iniquité, Mangé le fruit du mensonge; Car tu as eu confiance dans ta voie, Dans le nombre de tes vaillants hommes.
verses.am: ክፋትን አርሳችኋል፥ ኃጢአትንም አጭዳችኋል፥ የሐሰትንም ፍሬ በልታችኋል፤ በኃያላንህ ብዛት፥ በመንገድህም ላይ ታምነሃልና።

verses.en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Betharbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
verses.fr: Il s''élèvera un tumulte parmi ton peuple, Et toutes tes forteresses seront détruites, Comme fut détruite Schalman Beth-Arbel, Au jour de la guerre, Où la mère fut écrasée avec les enfants.
verses.am: በሕዝብህም መካከል ሽብር ይነሣል፤ እናትም ከልጆችዋ ጋር በተፈጠፈጠች ጊዜ ሰልማን ቤትአርብኤልን በሰልፍ ቀን እንዳፈረሰ፥ አምባዎችህ ሁሉ ይፈርሳሉ።

verses.en: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
verses.fr: Voilà ce que vous attirera Béthel, A cause de votre extrême méchanceté, Vienne l''aurore, et c''en est fait du roi d''Israël.
verses.am: ከኃጢአታችሁም ክፋት የተነሣ ቤቴል እንዲሁ ያደርግባችኋል፤ በነጋ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ፈጽሞ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
verses.fr: Quand Israël était jeune, je l''aimais, Et j''appelai mon fils hors d''Egypte.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሕፃን በነበረ ጊዜ ወደድሁት፥ ልጄንም ከግብጽ ጠራሁት።

verses.en: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
verses.fr: Mais ils se sont éloignés de ceux qui les appelaient; Ils ont sacrifié aux Baals, Et offert de l''encens aux idoles.
verses.am: አብዝቼ ብጠራቸው አጥብቀው ከፊቴ ራቁ፤ ለበኣሊምም ይሠዉ ነበር፥ ለተቀረጹ ምስሎችም ያጥኑ ነበር።

verses.en: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
verses.fr: C''est moi qui guidai les pas d''Ephraïm, Le soutenant par ses bras; Et ils n''ont pas vu que je les guérissais.
verses.am: እኔም ኤፍሬምን ክንዱን ይዤ በእግሩ እንዲሄድ መራሁት፤ እኔም እፈውሳቸው እንደ ነበርሁ አላወቁም።

verses.en: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
verses.fr: Je les tirai avec des liens d''humanité, avec des cordages d''amour, Je fus pour eux comme celui qui aurait relâché le joug près de leur bouche, Et je leur présentai de la nourriture.
verses.am: በሰው ገመድ በፍቅርም እስራት ሳብኋቸው፤ ለእነርሱም ቀምበርን ከጫንቃቸው ላይ እንደሚያነሣ ሆንሁ፥ ድርቆሽም ጣልሁላቸው።

verses.en: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, and the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
verses.fr: Ils ne retourneront pas au pays d''Egypte; Mais l''Assyrien sera leur roi, Parce qu''ils ont refusé de revenir à moi.
verses.am: ወደ እኔ ይመለሱ ዘንድ አልወደዱምና ወደ ግብጽ ምድር ይመለሳሉ፥ አሦርም ንጉሣቸው ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
verses.fr: L''épée fondra sur leurs villes, Anéantira, dévorera leurs soutiens, A cause des desseins qu''ils ont eus.
verses.am: ከመከሩትም ምክር የተነሣ ሰይፍ በከተሞቻቸው ላይ ይወድቃል፥ ከበርቴዎችንም ያጠፋል።

verses.en: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.
verses.fr: Mon peuple est enclin à s''éloigner de moi; On les rappelle vers le Très-Haut, Mais aucun d''eux ne l''exalte.
verses.am: ሕዝቤም ከእኔ ይመለሱ ዘንድ ወደዱ፤ ወደ ላይም ቢጠሩአቸው ማንም ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ አይችልም።

verses.en: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
verses.fr: Que ferai-je de toi, Ephraïm? Dois-je te livrer, Israël? Te traiterai-je comme Adma? Te rendrai-je semblable à Tseboïm? Mon coeur s''agite au dedans de moi, Toutes mes compassions sont émues.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ሆይ፥ እንዴት እጥልሃለሁ? እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እንዴትስ አሳልፌ እሰጥሃለሁ? እንዴትስ እንደ አዳማ እጥልሃለሁ? እንዴትስ እንደ ሲባዮ አደርግሃለሁ? ልቤ በውስጤ ተናውጣለች፥ ምሕረቴም ተነሣሥታለች።

verses.en: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.
verses.fr: Je n''agirai pas selon mon ardente colère, Je renonce à détruire Ephraïm; Car je suis Dieu, et non pas un homme, Je suis le Saint au milieu de toi; Je ne viendrai pas avec colère.
verses.am: እኔ አምላክ ነኝ እንጂ ሰው አይደለሁምና፥ በመካከልህም ቅዱሱ ነኝና የቁጣዬን መቅሠፍት አላደርግም፥ ኤፍሬምንም አጠፋ ዘንድ አልመለስም፤ በመዓትም አልመጣም።

verses.en: They shall walk after the Lord: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
verses.fr: Ils suivront l''Eternel, qui rugira comme un lion, Car il rugira, et les enfants accourront de la mer.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ይከተላሉ፥ እርሱም እንደ አንበሳ ያገሣል፤ ባገሣም ጊዜ ልጆች እየተንቀጠቀጡ ከምዕራብ ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils accourront de l''Egypte, comme un oiseau, Et du pays d''Assyrie, comme une colombe. Et je les ferai habiter dans leurs maisons, dit l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንደ ወፍም ከግብጽ፥ እንደ ርግብም ከአሦር ምድር እየተንቀጠቀጡ ይመጣሉ፤ በቤታቸውም አኖራቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
verses.fr: Ephraïm m''entoure de mensonge, Et la maison d''Israël de tromperie; Juda est encore sans frein vis-à-vis de Dieu, Vis-à-vis du Saint fidèle.

verses.en: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
verses.fr: Ephraïm se repaît de vent, et poursuit le vent d''orient; Chaque jour il multiplie le mensonge et la violence; Il fait alliance avec l''Assyrie, Et on porte de l''huile en Egypte.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም በሐሰት፥ የእስራኤልም ቤት በተንኰል ከበበኝ፤ ይሁዳም ከታመነው ቅዱሱ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አይጸናም።

verses.en: The Lord hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est aussi en contestation avec Juda, Et il punira Jacob pour sa conduite, Il lui rendra selon ses oeuvres.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ነፋስን ይበላል፥ የምሥራቅንም ነፋስ ይከተላል፤ ሁልጊዜም ሐሰትንና ተንኰልን ያበዛል፤ ከአሦር ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ያደርጋሉ፥ ወደ ግብጽም ዘይት ይወስዳሉ።

verses.en: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
verses.fr: Dans le sein maternel Jacob saisit son frère par le talon, Et dans sa vigueur, il lutta avec Dieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ ከይሁዳ ጋር ክርክር አለው፥ ያዕቆብንም እንደ መንገዱ ይቀጣል፤ እንደ ሥራውም ይመልስለታል።

verses.en: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Bethel, and there he spake with us;
verses.fr: Il lutta avec l''ange, et il fut vainqueur, Il pleura, et lui adressa des supplications. Jacob l''avait trouvé à Béthel, Et c''est là que Dieu nous a parlé.
verses.am: በማኅፀን ውስጥ ወንድሙን በተረከዙ ያዘው፥ በጕልማስነቱም ጊዜ ከአምላክ ጋር ታገለ፤

verses.en: Even the Lord God of hosts; the Lord is his memorial.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est le Dieu des armées; Son nom est l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከመልአኩም ጋር ታግሎ አሸነፈ፤ አልቅሶም ለመነው። በቤቴልም አገኘው፥ በዚያም ከእኛ ጋር ተነጋገረ።

verses.en: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment and wait on thy God continually.
verses.fr: Et toi, reviens à ton Dieu, Garde la piété et la justice, Et espère toujours en ton Dieu.
verses.am: እርሱም የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የመታሰቢያው ስም እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
verses.fr: Ephraïm est un marchand qui a dans sa main des balances fausses, Il aime à tromper.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወደ አምላክህ ተመለስ፤ ምሕረትንና ፍርድን ጠብቅ፥ ዘወትርም በአምላክህ ታመን።

verses.en: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.
verses.fr: Et Ephraïm dit: A la vérité, je me suis enrichi, J''ai acquis de la fortune; Mais c''est entièrement le produit de mon travail; On ne trouvera chez moi aucune iniquité, rien qui soit un crime.
verses.am: ከከነዓን ወገን ነው፤ በእጁ የተንኰል ሚዛን አለ፥ ሽንገላንም ይወድዳል።

verses.en: And I that am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
verses.fr: Et moi, je suis l''Eternel, ton Dieu, dès le pays d''Egypte; Je te ferai encore habiter sous des tentes, comme aux jours de fêtes.
verses.am: ኤፍሬምም። ባለ ጠጋ ሆኜአለሁ፥ ሀብትንም አግኝቻለሁ፥ በድካሜም ሁሉ ኃጢአት የሚሆን በደል አይገኝብኝም አለ።

verses.en: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
verses.fr: J''ai parlé aux prophètes, J''ai multiplié les visions, Et par les prophètes j''ai proposé des paraboles.
verses.am: እኔም ከግብጽ ጀምሬ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ እንደ ዓመት በዓል ቀን እንደ ገና በድንኳን እንድትኖር አደርግሃለሁ።

verses.en: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
verses.fr: Si Galaad n''est que néant, ils seront certainement anéantis. Ils sacrifient des boeufs dans Guilgal: Aussi leurs autels seront comme des monceaux de pierres Sur les sillons des champs.
verses.am: ለነቢያትም ተናግሬአለሁ፥ ራእይንም አብዝቻለሁ፤ በነቢያትም እጅ ምሳሌዎችን አውጥቻለሁ።

verses.en: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
verses.fr: Jacob s''enfuit au pays d''Aram, Israël servit pour une femme, Et pour une femme il garda les troupeaux.
verses.am: ኃጢአት በገለዓድ አለ፤ ፈጽመው ከንቱ ናቸው፤ ወይፈኖች በጌልገላ ይሠዋሉ፥ መሠዊያዎቻቸውም በእርሻ ትልም ላይ የድንጋይ ክምር ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And by a prophet the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
verses.fr: Par un prophète l''Eternel fit monter Israël hors d''Egypte, Et par un prophète Israël fut gardé.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ወደ ሶርያ አገር ሸሸ፥ እስራኤልም ስለ ሚስት አገለገለ፥ ስለ ሚስትም ጠባቂ ነበረ።

verses.en: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
verses.fr: Ephraïm a irrité l''Eternel amèrement: Son Seigneur rejettera sur lui le sang qu''il a répandu, Il fera retomber sur lui la honte qui lui appartient.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በነቢይ እጅ እስራኤልን ከግብጽ አወጣ፥ በነቢይም እጅ ጠበቀው።

verses.en: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''Ephraïm parlait, c''était une terreur: Il s''élevait en Israël. Mais il s''est rendu coupable par Baal, et il est mort.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም በተናገረ ጊዜ ፍርሃት ነበረ፥ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ታበየ፤ ነገር ግን በኣልን በማምለክ በበደለ ጊዜ ሞተ።

verses.en: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
verses.fr: Maintenant ils continuent à pécher, Ils se font avec leur argent des images en fonte, Des idoles de leur invention; Toutes sont l''oeuvre des artisans. On dit à leur sujet: Que ceux qui sacrifient baisent les veaux!
verses.am: አሁንም ኃጢአትን ይሠሩ ዘንድ ጨመሩ፤ በብራቸውም ለራሳቸው ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስልን፥ እንደ ጥበባቸውም ጣዖታትን ሠርተዋል፤ ሁሉም የሠራተኛ ሥራ ናቸው። ስለ እነርሱም። የሚሠዉ ሰዎች እምቦሳውን ይሳሙ ይላሉ።

verses.en: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ils seront comme la nuée du matin, Comme la rosée qui bientôt se dissipe, Comme la balle emportée par le vent hors de l''aire, Comme la fumée qui sort d''une fenêtre.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እንደ ማለዳ ደመና፥ በጥዋትም እንደሚያልፍ ጠል፥ በዐውሎ ነፍስም ከአውድማ እንደሚበተን እብቅ፥ ከመስኮትም እንደሚወጣ ጢስ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Yet I am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.
verses.fr: Et moi, je suis l''Eternel, ton Dieu, dès le pays d''Egypte. Tu ne connais d''autre Dieu que moi, Et il n''y a de sauveur que moi.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ከግብጽ ምድር ጀምሬ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ አምላክ አታውቅም፥ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ መድኃኒት የለም።

verses.en: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
verses.fr: Je t''ai connu dans le désert, Dans une terre aride.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ፥ እጅግ በደረቀ ምድር አውቄህ ነበር።

verses.en: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
verses.fr: Ils se sont rassasiés dans leurs pâturages; Ils se sont rassasiés, et leur coeur s''est enflé; C''est pourquoi ils m''ont oublié.
verses.am: ከተሰማሩ በኋላ ጠገቡ፥ በጠገቡም ጊዜ ልባቸው ታበየ፤ ስለዚህ ረሱኝ።

verses.en: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
verses.fr: Je serai pour eux comme un lion; Comme une panthère, je les épierai sur la route.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እኔ እንደ አንበሳ ሆንሁባቸው፥ እንደ ነብርም በመንገድ አጠገብ አደባባቸዋለሁ፤

verses.en: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
verses.fr: Je les attaquerai, comme une ourse à qui l''on a enlevé ses petits, Et je déchirerai l''enveloppe de leur coeur; Je les dévorerai, comme une lionne; Les bêtes des champs les mettront en pièces.
verses.am: ልጅዋ እንደ ተነጠቀባት ድብ እገጥማቸዋለሁ፥ የልባቸውንም ስብ እቀድዳለሁ፤ በዚያም እንደ አንበሳ እበላቸዋለሁ፥ የምድረ በዳም አውሬ ይነጣጠቃቸዋል።

verses.en: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.
verses.fr: Ce qui cause ta ruine, Israël, C''est que tu as été contre moi, contre celui qui pouvait te secourir.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ በእኔ በረዳትህ ላይ በመነሣትህ ጥፋትህ ነው።

verses.en: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
verses.fr: Où donc est ton roi? Qu''il te délivre dans toutes tes villes! Où sont tes juges, au sujet desquels tu disais: Donne-moi un roi et des princes?
verses.am: በየከተማህ ሁሉ ያድንህ ዘንድ ንጉሥህ ወዴት አለ? ስለ እነርሱም። ንጉሥንና አለቆችን ስጠኝ ብለህ የተናገርኸው መሳፍንቶችህ ወዴት አሉ?

verses.en: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.
verses.fr: Je t''ai donné un roi dans ma colère, Je te l''ôterai dans ma fureur.
verses.am: በቍጣዬ ንጉሥን ሰጠሁህ፥ በመዓቴም ሻርሁት።

verses.en: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
verses.fr: L''iniquité d''Ephraïm est gardée, Son péché est mis en réserve.
verses.am: የኤፍሬም በደል ታስሮአል፥ ኃጢአቱም ተከማችቶአል።

verses.en: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
verses.fr: Les douleurs de celle qui enfante viendront pour lui; C''est un enfant peu sage, Qui, au terme voulu, ne sort pas du sein maternel.
verses.am: ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ጭንቅ ይመጣበታል፤ በሚወለድበት ጊዜ በማኅፀን አፍ ቀጥ ብሎ አይወጣምና አእምሮ የሌለው ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
verses.fr: Je les rachèterai de la puissance du séjour des morts, Je les délivrerai de la mort. O mort, où est ta peste? Séjour des morts, où est ta destruction? Mais le repentir se dérobe à mes regards!
verses.am: ከሲኦል እጅ እታደጋቸዋለሁ፥ ከሞትም እቤዣቸዋለሁ፤ ሞት ሆይ፥ ቸነፈርህ ወዴት አለ? ሲኦል ሆይ፥ ማጥፋትህ ወዴት አለ? ርኅራኄ ከዓይኔ ተሰወረች።

verses.en: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the Lord shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
verses.fr: Ephraïm a beau être fertile au milieu de ses frères, Le vent d''orient viendra, le vent de l''Eternel s''élèvera du désert, Desséchera ses sources, tarira ses fontaines. On pillera le trésor de tous les objets précieux.
verses.am: በወንድሞቹ መካከል ፍሬያማ ቢሆን የምሥራቅ ነፋስ ይመጣል፥ የእግዚአብሔር ነፋስ ከምድረ በዳ ይመጣል፤ ምንጩንም ያደርቃል፥ ፈሳሹንም ያጠፋል፥ የተከበሩ ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ያሉበትን መዝገብ ይበዘብዛል።

verses.en: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
verses.fr: Samarie sera punie, parce qu''elle s''est révoltée contre son Dieu. Ils tomberont par l''épée; Leurs petits enfants seront écrasés, Et l''on fendra le ventre de leurs femmes enceintes.
verses.am: ሰማርያ በአምላክዋ ላይ ዐምፃለችና በደልዋን ትሸከማለች፤ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፥ ሕፃኖቻቸውም ይፈጠፈጣሉ፥ እርጕዞቻቸውም ይቀደዳሉ።

verses.en: O israel, return unto the Lord thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
verses.fr: Israël, reviens à l''Eternel, ton Dieu, Car tu es tombé par ton iniquité.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ በኃጢአትህ ወድቀሃልና ወደ አምላክህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለስ።

verses.en: Take with you words, and turn to the Lord: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
verses.fr: Apportez avec vous des paroles, Et revenez à l''Eternel. Dites-lui: Pardonne toutes les iniquités, Et reçois-nous favorablement! Nous t''offrirons, au lieu de taureaux, l''hommage de nos lèvres.
verses.am: ከእናንተ ጋር ቃልን ውሰዱ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ተመልሳችሁ። ኃጢአትን ሁሉ አስወግድ፥ በቸርነትም ተቀበለን፥ በወይፈንም ፋንታ የከንፈራችንን ፍሬ እንሰጣለን።

verses.en: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
verses.fr: L''Assyrien ne nous sauvera pas, nous ne monterons pas sur des chevaux, Et nous ne dirons plus à l''ouvrage de nos mains: Notre Dieu! Car c''est auprès de toi que l''orphelin trouve compassion.
verses.am: አሦር አያድነንም፤ በፈረስ ላይ አንቀመጥም፤ ድሀ አደጉም በአንተ ዘንድ ምሕረትን ያገኛልና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ለእጆቻችን ሥራ። አምላኮቻችን ናችሁ አንላቸውም በሉት።

verses.en: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
verses.fr: Je réparerai leur infidélité, J''aurai pour eux un amour sincère; Car ma colère s''est détournée d''eux.
verses.am: ቍጣዬ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ተመልሶአልና ዓመፃቸውን እፈውሳለሁ፥ በገዛ ፈቃዴ እወድዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
verses.fr: Je serai comme la rosée pour Israël, Il fleurira comme le lis, Et il poussera des racines comme le Liban.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም እንደ ጠል እሆነዋለሁ፤ እንደ አበባም ያብባል፥ እንደ ሊባኖስም ሥሩን ይሰድዳል።

verses.en: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
verses.fr: Ses rameaux s''étendront; Il aura la magnificence de l''olivier, Et les parfums du Liban.
verses.am: ቅርንጫፎቹም ይዘረጋሉ፥ ውበቱም እንደ ወይራ፥ ሽታውም እንደ ሊባኖስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
verses.fr: Ils reviendront s''asseoir à son ombre, Ils redonneront la vie au froment, Et ils fleuriront comme la vigne; Ils auront la renommée du vin du Liban.
verses.am: ከጥላውም በታች የሚቀመጡ ይመለሳሉ፤ ከእህሉም የተነሣ ይጠግባሉ፤ እንደ ወይንም አረግ ያብባሉ፤ መታሰቢያውም እንደ ሊባኖስ ወይን ጠጅ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
verses.fr: Ephraïm, qu''ai-je à faire encore avec les idoles? Je l''exaucerai, je le regarderai, Je serai pour lui comme un cyprès verdoyant. C''est de moi que tu recevras ton fruit.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ ጣዖት ለኤፍሬም ምንድር ነው? እኔ ሰምቼዋለሁ፥ ወደ እርሱም እመለከታለሁ፤ እኔ እንደ ለመለመ ጥድ ነኝ፤ ፍሬህ በእኔ ዘንድ ይገኛል።

verses.en: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the Lord are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
verses.fr: Que celui qui est sage prenne garde à ces choses! Que celui qui est intelligent les comprenne! Car les voies de l''Eternel sont droites; Les justes y marcheront, Mais les rebelles y tomberont.
verses.am: ይህን ነገር የሚያስተውል ጠቢብ፥ የሚያውቃትም አስተዋይ ማን ነው? የእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ቅን ነው፥ ጻድቃንም ይሄዱበታል፤ ተላላፊዎች ግን ይወድቁበታል።
